plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: bridges the computer-use-linux MCP server into DSH as native mcp__cul__* tools — AT-SPI accessibility trees, screenshots, window targeting, and Wayland/X11 input for Linux desktop control.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-computer-use-linux

[![CI](https://github.com/BruceZhang1993/dsh-computer-use-linux/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://github.com/BruceZhang1993/dsh-computer-use-linux/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-brightgreen.svg)](package.json)
[![Platform: Linux](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-linux-blue.svg)](https://www.kernel.org)
[![DeepSeek Harness plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4B6BFB.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-stdio-6E56CF.svg)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io)

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**Linux desktop computer use for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)** —
the [`computer-use-linux`](https://github.com/agent-sh/computer-use-linux) MCP
server bridged into DSH as native tools, with its skill bundled.

The agent can observe the local desktop (AT-SPI accessibility trees, window
lists, screenshots) and act on it (focus/move/resize windows, click, drag,
scroll, type, press keys, invoke accessibility actions) — on Wayland or X11,
through the same tools Claude Code and Codex get from the upstream plugin.

No DSH modifications. No runtime dependencies. The bridge is the in-box
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` plugin.

## Architecture

```
DSH agent
  │  tools: mcp__cul__doctor, mcp__cul__get_app_state, mcp__cul__click, … (18)
  ▼
@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client        ← in-box DSH bridge (official MCP SDK, stdio)
  │  newline-framed JSON-RPC 2.0
  ▼
bin/computer-use-linux-mcp.mjs     ← this package: resolve → verify → exec
  ▼
computer-use-linux mcp             ← pinned upstream release (Rust, ~9 MB)
  ├─ AT-SPI registry   → accessibility trees, semantic actions
  ├─ compositor backends → window list / focus (GNOME, KWin, Hyprland, niri, i3, COSMIC, X11/EWMH)
  ├─ portals / Shell   → screenshots
  └─ ydotool / portal / xdotool → input synthesis
```

Two decisions define this integration:

- **Bridge, don't reimplement.** The upstream server is the supported desktop
  engine and it already speaks MCP. Wrapping it as DSH native tools keeps every
  upstream fix one version bump away, and the DSH MCP bridge owns naming,
  reconnection, image projection, and cancellation.
- **Isolate the device layer.** A small resolver owns the only piece that is
  inherently machine-specific: which binary to run. That is the one place worth
  custom code, and it is testable without a desktop.

## Requirements

- Linux (x86_64 or arm64). The plugin is disabled on other platforms.
- DeepSeek Harness with the in-box `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` available
  (every shipped profile already has it).
- Node 20+ for the launcher. Inside DSH Desktop the launcher runs under the
  Electron binary via `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`.
- A desktop session. Accessibility, window targeting, and input backends are
  per-compositor concerns — run `mcp__cul__doctor` and see
  `skills/computer-use-linux/references/setup.md`.

## Install

Install the plugin as a DSH bundle — there is no manual patch or config edit.
The full guide, including GitHub Packages authentication and the pre-download
step, is [docs/installation.md](docs/installation.md).

### CLI profiles — from GitHub Packages (normal install)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @brucezhang1993/dsh-computer-use-linux          # latest
dsh plugin --profile web add @brucezhang1993/dsh-computer-use-linux@0.1.0    # pin a version
```

`dsh plugin` delegates to pnpm in the profile directory, checks the package
against the running DSH version before downloading anything, and once the
install succeeds selects the bundle in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` —
that selection is what makes the profile layer load. Then restart the harness.
The model's tool list gains `mcp__cul__doctor`, `mcp__cul__get_app_state`,
`mcp__cul__list_windows`, `mcp__cul__click`, and the rest.

The package is served by GitHub Packages and installs are authenticated there.
Make the scope mapping visible to the profile, and log in once per machine:

```sh
printf '@brucezhang1993:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com\n' \
  >> "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/web/.npmrc"
npm login --scope=@brucezhang1993 --auth-type=legacy \
  --registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com
```

`--auth-type=legacy` is required on npm 9+ so the CLI prompts instead of opening
a browser, and the password is a **classic personal access token** with
`read:packages` — not the token `gh auth login` stores. See
[docs/installation.md](docs/installation.md#authenticate-to-github-packages-once-per-machine)
for the token scopes, why the token goes to `~/.npmrc`, and how to make the
package public if you want unauthenticated installs.

### DSH Desktop — from GitHub Packages

Open the plugin manager and install `@brucezhang1993/dsh-computer-use-linux`
from the registry (search by name). Desktop profiles are managed exclusively by
the app, so `dsh plugin --profile desktop add …` is refused by design.

### From a local checkout (development)

While working on this repository, install the working copy instead of the
published tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-computer-use-linux
```

pnpm links the directory, so the bundle behaves exactly like the npm install
and your edits apply on the next restart. No `npm pack`/`npm publish` step in
between. See [Development](#development) for the repository layout and its
self-checks.

## Verify

In a session, ask the agent to call `mcp__cul__doctor` first: it returns the
platform, portals, accessibility, windowing and input backends, and a readiness
summary.

From a source checkout:

```sh
node scripts/check-package.mjs   # static: patch, exports, skill consistency
node --test                      # unit + launcher tests
node scripts/doctor.mjs          # desktop readiness report, no DSH needed
node scripts/selftest.mjs        # MCP handshake + tools/list through the launcher
```

`check-package` and the unit tests live in the source tree; the runtime probes
ship inside the package, so an installed copy can still run `selftest.mjs` and
`doctor.mjs`. The exact commands, including the installed-copy paths, are in
[docs/installation.md](docs/installation.md#verify-the-install).

## Tools

All 18 default upstream tools are exposed, namespaced as `mcp__cul__<tool>`.

| Group | Tools |
| --- | --- |
| Diagnostics | `doctor`, `setup_accessibility`, `setup_window_targeting` |
| Discovery | `list_apps`, `list_windows`, `focused_window` |
| Observation | `get_app_state`, `screenshot` |
| Input | `click`, `drag`, `scroll`, `press_key`, `type_text` |
| Semantic | `perform_action`, `set_value` |
| Windows | `activate_window`, `move_window`, `resize_window` |

Two conditional upstream tools stay off unless the environment opts in:
`run_shell` (`COMPUTER_USE_LINUX_ENABLE_SHELL=1`, deliberately unsandboxed — DSH
already has a sandboxed shell tool) and `complete_interaction`
(`COMPUTER_USE_LINUX_NOTIFY_ON_COMPLETE=1`).

## How the binary is resolved

In order, first hit wins:

1. `COMPUTER_USE_LINUX_BIN` — an absolute path (a local build, or
   `cargo install computer-use-linux`).
2. `~/.cache/computer-use-linux/plugin/v<version>/computer-use-linux` — the
   plugin cache. **The same layout as the upstream Claude Code / Codex plugin**,
   so one download serves every host on the machine.
3. the `@agent-sh/computer-use-linux` npm package, if installed.
4. `computer-use-linux` on `PATH`.
5. a GitHub release download, verified against the published `.sha256`.

Downloads are staged and renamed, so concurrent first starts and killed
downloads cannot leave a half-written binary. Version and mirror are
overridable: `COMPUTER_USE_LINUX_VERSION`, `COMPUTER_USE_LINUX_DOWNLOAD_BASE`,
`COMPUTER_USE_LINUX_SKIP_DOWNLOAD`.
[docs/installation.md](docs/installation.md#binary-resolution) covers each hit
and when to prefer it.

## What the bundle adds

```yaml
# cordis.patch.yml — the whole declarative surface
- insert:
    - id: mcp-computer-use-linux      # one MCP server row, tool

plugins.description: 把原本独立的 MCP 直连管理器 `dsh-mcp-direct` 封装成 DSH 持久化插件，并在 Web GUI 内提供 MCP 服务器管理界面。绕开DSH 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`导致的Desktop 宿主 V8 OOM 崩溃
plugins.readme_text:
# DSHDirect

> 把原本独立的 MCP 直连管理器 `dsh-mcp-direct` 封装成 DSH 持久化插件，并在 Web GUI 内提供 MCP 服务器管理界面。绕开 DSH 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 导致的 Desktop 宿主 V8 OOM 崩溃。

**Also available in [中文 (README.zh-CN.md)](README.zh-CN.md).**

# dsh-mcp-direct

**A direct MCP client and manager for DeepSeek Harness that never registers a model tool.**

MCP connections run entirely in short-lived child processes, so the host's resident
cost for MCP support is **zero** — which is the whole point, because the built-in
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` registers every MCP tool into `ctx.tools` and, on a
host already near its V8 heap ceiling, that registration is what tips it into OOM.

- **CLI** — `mcp-direct add <name> <url>` registers a server in one line and generates
  a global `<name>-mcp` command plus a skill that teaches the model to use it.
- **Plugin** — a management UI inside the Web GUI: list, probe, inspect schemas,
  call tools, add and remove servers.

Both surfaces share one `lib/core.js` and one `servers.json`, so **the CLI and the
GUI cannot drift**.

---

## Why this exists

The failure is not vague. It is one specific allocation:

1. The host is an Electron process with a V8 heap capped near **4 GB**, already
   climbing close to it under normal use.
2. `dsh-mcp-client` connects a server and then registers **every tool into
   `ctx.tools`**.
3. That path loads `@modelcontextprotocol/client` into the **host process** — about
   **27 MB of resident memory that GC does not reclaim**, because it is a module
   graph rather than transient garbage.
4. So "open the MCP manager page" becomes the final allocation before the heap
   gives out:

```
OOM error in V8: MarkCompactCollector ... 3938.9 (4074.0) MB
```

The blast radius is concrete too: `POST /list` is the first place the host
`require()`s the SDK. Everything is healthy until that request, and then the
process is gone — taking the session and every live page connection with it.

### The core invariant

```
never register any MCP tool into the host tool runtime — not one.
```

That is a design precondition, not an optimization. To hold it, all MCP work is
pushed out of the host:

```
GUI (client.js)
  │  fetch POST (loopback only)
  ▼
Host bridge (index.js)          → registry IO and process management only; never requires the SDK
  │  spawn
  ▼
mcp-worker.js                   → short-lived child; does the work, prints one JSON line, exits
  │  require
  ▼
@modelcontextprotocol/client    → the official SDK, process-isolated
```

So the host's MCP-related resident memory is **0**, and a hung or crashing MCP
server can only kill a child.

---

## What it fixes

| # | Problem | With a conventional MCP bridge | With dsh-mcp-direct |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Host OOM crash** | Opening the MCP page kills the process; session and page connections are lost | The SDK loads only in a child; host resident cost is zero |
| 2 | **One hung server stalls everything** | A server that stops responding freezes the host | Child process per operation with a hard timeout (20 s default), killed on expiry |
| 3 | **Tool count pollutes context** | N servers × M tools all injected into the model's tool table, bloating every turn | Zero tools registered; the model calls the `<name>-mcp` command on demand |
| 4 | **CLI and GUI disagree** | Each keeps its own config; a server added by CLI is invisible in the UI | Single `servers.json` source of truth, shared `lib/core.js` |
| 5 | **No UI** | Adding a server means hand-editing JSON and guessing tool names and arguments | Full GUI: list, probe, schema browser, call panel, add/remove |
| 6 | **Unknowable failures** | A bare `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` or a silent no-op | Failures list **every path tried**; the list view shows per-server tool count, latency, and the raw error |
| 7 | **Hardcoded SDK path** | A stale leftover app copy gets picked up instead of the running install | Four-stage probe, with the *running* interpreter first |
| 8 | **The model doesn't know the route** | It keeps reaching for the OOM-crashing client | `add` generates a skill that states plainly: do not use MCP tools, use this command |

### On point 3: this is a trade, not a gap

The native DSH approach turns MCP tools into model tools so the model can call them
directly. This project **deliberately gives that up** in exchange for a **CLI gateway
plus a skill**:

- The model sees "there is a `cocos` MCP server; drive it with `cocos-mcp`" —
  **not** 22 tool definitions.
- When it needs an argument shape it runs `cocos-mcp schema <tool>` and gets the
  `inputSchema`, then calls.
- The cost is one extra schema lookup. The payoff is a host that does not die and a
  context that is not flooded with tool tables.

**Against a 4 GB heap ceiling, that trade is the only version that stays up.**

---

## Repository layout

```
.
├─ packages/
│  ├─ cli/                    standalone CLI (the shared core lives here)
│  │  ├─ mcp-direct.js        command entry point
│  │  ├─ package.json
│  │  └─ lib/
│  │     ├─ core.js           SDK resolution, registry, connect, artifacts — shared
│  │     └─ mcp-worker.js     one MCP operation per process
│  └─ plugin/                 DSH Desktop plugin bundle
│     ├─ package.json         manifest (bundle patch + dsh.client)
│     ├─ cordis.patch.yml     inserts the id=mcp-direct plugin row
│     ├─ index.js             host half: bridge routes + admission guard
│     ├─ client.js            client half: the management UI
│     └─ icon.svg
├─ tests/
│  ├─ run.js                  suite runner
│  ├─ unit/core.test.js       pure helpers — no network, no SDK
│  ├─ e2e/cli.test.js         the real CLI against a real stdio MCP server
│  └─ fixtures/echo-server.js a dependency-free MCP server for the tests
├─ docs/
│  ├─ architecture.md         design decisions and their evidence
│  └─ troubleshooting.md      what to check when something does not connect
├─ LICENSE
└─ README.md
```

The plugin loads `lib/core.js` from the CLI package, which is what keeps one
implementation behind both surfaces.

---

## Install

### Requirements

- Windows (the generated launchers are `.cmd`; the Node code is portable)
- Node.js 18+ **or** a DSH Desktop install (the launcher falls back to running the
  Desktop binary as plain Node via `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`)
- The `@modelcontextprotocol/client` SDK, which ships **inside the DSH Desktop app**
  and is resolved at runtime — it is not vendored here

### 1. CLI only

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/weimingyu9312/DSHDirect.git
cd DSHDirect\packages\cli
node mcp-direct.js list
```

To get global `<name>-mcp` commands, put the CLI directory on your `PATH`. Then:

```powershell
node mcp-direct.js add cocos http://127.0.0.1:3100/mcp
cocos-mcp tools
```

### 2. Install the plugin

The plugin needs the CLI package present, because it loads the shared `lib/core.js`
from it. The conventional layout is:

```
<bin>/                     ← on your PATH
├─ tools/dsh-mcp-direct/   ← packages/cli contents go here
│  ├─ mcp-direct.js
│  └─ lib/
└─ <name>-mcp.cmd          ← generated launchers land here
```

Then install the bundle into your DSH profile:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <path-to-repo>\packages\plugin
```

The plugin's patch row is intentionally **config-free**. Every path is detected:

| Path | Default |
|---|---|
| `toolDir` | `MCPD_HOME`, else `~/.dsh/tools/dsh-mcp-direct`, else first PATH entry containing `tools/dsh-mcp-direct` |
| `registryPath` | `<toolDir>/servers.json` |
| `binDir` | `MCPD_HOME`, else the PATH directory for a `tools/dsh-mcp-direct` layout, else `toolDir` |
| `skillsDir` | `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\skills` |
| `probeTimeoutMs` | `8000` |

Override any of them under `config:` in `cordis.patch.yml` only if you relocate the
CLI. Leaving them unset keeps the row a pure `insert`, which matters because the
profile runs with `patchReload: live`: a config value that differs from the declared
default forces a reconcile on every enable/disable, and combined with the
`disabled: true` row the Plugin Manager writes, that produced a reload loop which
killed live page connections with `ECONNRESET`.

After installing, restart DSH Deskt

plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）加一段视频开机片头：启动时全屏播放 mp4、点击或 Esc 跳过、可导入自己的视频（解不了的编码自动转码成 H.264）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-boot-video

**给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）加一段视频开机片头。**
启动客户端时全屏播放你的 mp4，播完淡出、露出真正的界面；点击画面或按 `Esc` 随时跳过。

*Full-screen video boot splash for DSH.*

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-boot-video?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-boot-video) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/xufu5438-netizen/dsh-boot-video?label=GitHub)](https://github.com/xufu5438-netizen/dsh-boot-video)

![桌面版实机预览：视频铺满窗口，左下角「打开声音」、右下角「点击画面跳过」](docs/preview-desktop.png)

---

## 特性

- 🎬 **一段 mp4 = 一次开机片头**：全屏播放，播完淡出进界面，不是"加载完成就切走"
- ⏭️ **随时跳过**：点击画面或按 `Esc`
- 🔊 **桌面版直接带着声音播出**（Electron 默认允许未静音自动播放）；网页版会被浏览器拦下，于是自动降级成静音并亮出「打开声音」按钮（点它只开声、不跳过）
- 🖥️ **盖住 DSH 自己的开机卡片**：首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段注入，`HARNESS / Loading plugins…` 不会露脸
- 🔀 **不跟别的片头插件打架**：各写自己的 localStorage 键，同时装也不会互相干扰
- 🖼️ **不裁画面**：始终按完整比例居中显示；片源自带的那圈黑边在压制素材时就裁掉了
- 📦 **零运行时依赖**：宿主半边只用 `node:` 内建模块，浏览器半边只有一条 `<video>`
- ⚙️ **设置单开一页**：设置侧边栏里的「开机动画」，开关 / 素材 / 预览都在那儿，不挤在「通用设置」里
- 🩺 **自检行**：设置页底部写着"客户端半边是什么时候加载的、上次开机到底播成功没有"——
  改了没生效 / 视频打不开，看一眼就知道
- 🔄 **导入的视频会自动转码**：解不了的编码（典型是 HEVC / H.265）不用你自己动手转——
  插件自己下 ffmpeg（国内镜像）转成 H.264 再收下，转完先验一遍能不能播

## 安装

```sh
# 从 npm 安装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-boot-video

# 从 GitHub 安装（仓库带构建产物，没有安装期脚本，不触发构建授权）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xufu5438-netizen/dsh-boot-video

# 或从本地目录安装（把路径换成你解压出来的目录）
dsh plugin --profile web add <本目录绝对路径>
```

装完**必须重启一次 DSH**（bundle 在启动时装配），然后 **Ctrl+Shift+R** 硬刷新——
DSH 的客户端 bundle 带 `max-age=31536000, immutable`，普通 F5 会一直用第一次抓到的副本。

> **桌面版（Electron）**：也可以在应用里走「设置 → 插件 → 添加插件」贴本目录路径（插件管理器原生支持
> 本地路径 / registry / git / tarball 四种 spec）。桌面版的 index 注入表在宿主启动时收集一次，
> 所以那里装完必须**完全退出并重新打开**，刷新页面不够。

### 卸载

```sh
# 命令行装的
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-boot-video
```

桌面版在「设置 → 插件」里点卸载即可。**卸载后开机会恢复成 DSH 自己的启动画面**——
本插件不留下任何全局改动（只写自己那几个 localStorage 键；想彻底还原则在控制台删掉
`dsh-boot-video:source` / `dsh-boot-video:asset` / `dsh-boot-video:last-boot` 三个键）。

### 自己打"发布包"（只带已授权的那段）

```sh
npm run pack:release
```

它会临时把「月读世界」那段从包内容里排除、打完立刻还原清单，并**核对包里到底有什么**
（一旦混进没授权的素材，它会删掉包并以非零码退出）。当前结果：**11.37 MB**，只含
`assets/hdd.mp4` + 代码 + 一张预览图。

## 使用

**设置 → 侧边栏「开机动画」**（0.3.0 起是独立一页，不再挂在「通用设置」里）：

| 控件 | 档位 | 效果 |
|---|---|---|
| 启动时播放 | **我的视频**（默认） | 启动时全屏播一短片头，播完淡出进界面 |
| | **不播放** | 启动直通界面（想恢复：设置页里点回「我的视频」，或在控制台删掉 `localStorage['dsh-boot-video:source']`） |
| 片头素材 | **HDD**（默认） | `assets/hdd.mp4`，10.47 MB |
| | **月读世界** | `assets/yuedu.mp4`，29.01 MB，4K/60fps 重压（CRF 24、PSNR 46.2 dB，肉眼无差） |
| 导入自己的视频 | **⬆ 导入视频** | 挑一段你自己的 mp4（上限 512 MB），存进插件的 `assets/user/`，以后随时能选、能删 |
| 预览 | **▶ 播放一遍** | 不重启就看看效果；正在播时点它会从头重播 |

换素材会立刻用新素材重播一遍——不用为了确认换了没有去重启。

### 导入自己的视频（0.8.0 起默认开启）

点「⬆ 导入视频」挑一段 mp4，它会被**原样存进插件的 `assets/user/`**（不转码、不重封装——
导进去什么样，播出来什么样），然后自动选上、播一遍，**并弹出起名窗口**。这是本插件的主功能之一；
不想让插件能写盘的话，跑 DSH 时设 `DSHBV_IMPORT=0` 就能把它关掉（客户端那侧对应 `IMPORT_ENABLED`）。

- **素材带**里点它 = 换成它；旁边的小「×」= 从插件里删掉这一份（**你自己的原片不受影响**）
- 下面的「我导入的视频」列表负责「改名」与「删除」；改名**只改显示名**（磁盘文件名不动），
  留空 = 回到原始文件名
- 网页版与桌面版都能导，插件内部走的是两条路：
  - **网页版**：文件本体流式传给 DSH（带进度条），宿主边收边写盘
  - **桌面版**：Electron 能把"你刚选的那个文件"翻成绝对路径，于是**宿主直接复制**，几百 MB 也很快；
    这条路不通（旧版 Electron / 跨盘 / 没权限）会自动回退到上传那条
- 想手动清也可以：直接删掉 `assets/user/` 里那几个 `u-*.mp4`（清单是按目录推导的，不会留残影）；
  自定义名字在同目录的 `labels.json` 里，删掉它就全回到原始文件名
- **导入的内容只在你机器上**：发布包里没有别人的视频，别人导入的也不会传到你这儿

#### ⚠️ 只收 **mp4**；编码不支持的**会自动转码**

导入只认 `.mp4`（不是 mp4 会在选择器与本地校验那里就拦住）。至于"里面是什么编码"——
**不用你操心**：

| 你手上的文件 | 会发生什么 |
|---|---|
| `.mp4` + H.264（剪映/手机导出、B 站下载的常见形态） | ✅ 直接导入 |
| `.mp4` + HEVC（不少"4K 片源"） | 🔄 导入时会问一句「要不要自动转换」，点一下插件自己把 ffmpeg 下下来（约 28MB，国内镜像）转成 H.264，转完自动收进素材列表 |
| 其它容器（`.mkv` / `.webm` / `.mov`） | ❌ 被拒；先剪成 mp4（剪映导出选 mp4 + H.264 最省事） |
| 不是视频的文件 | ❌ 被拒（"没找到视频轨"） |

转码用的是 `libx264 -crf 20`、**保持原分辨率与帧率**、音频 AAC 192k、`+faststart`；
转完插件**自己先验一遍能不能播**才收下。命令行等价物（不想用界面时）：

```sh
node scripts/import-hevc.mjs "D:\视频素材\你的母带.mkv"
```

> ⚠️ 导入的视频就在插件文件夹里，所以**重装/升级插件时可能被覆盖**——重装前先把
> `assets/user/` 里那几个文件挪出去，装完再放回来。

画面**不做裁切**：始终按完整比例居中显示。窗口比例与片子比例不一致时上下（或左右）会留黑边——
这是"保留全部画面"的代价。片源自带的那圈黑边已经在压制素材时裁掉了，剩下的黑边只是比例差。

> 曾经做过「铺满 / 完整」两档，看过两档之后决定删掉「铺满」：16:9 窗口播一条 2.35:1 的片子，
> 铺满要裁掉左右各约 12%，那是画面少了一块，不是更饱满。

- **桌面版（Electron）自动带声音播放**；网页版浏览器会拦未静音自动播放，于是自动降级静音、
  左下角亮出「打开声音」按钮（点它只开声，不跳过）。同一份代码，两边各得其所。

### 想让网页版也自动带声音？

做不到由插件说了算——网页里的 JS 绕不过浏览器的自动播放策略，只有 Electron 这种"自己就是浏览器"
的宿主能设 `no-user-gesture-required`。**但可以手动给这个站点开声音白名单**，开完插件一个字都不用改
（它本来就是"先试带声、被拒才降级"）：

| 浏览器 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| **Chrome / Edge（推荐，不用手输网址）** | 在 DSH 页面上点地址栏左边的站点图标 → 「网站设置」→ 找到「声音」→ 改成**允许** → 硬刷新 |
| Chrome | `chrome://settings/content/sound` → 「允许播放声音」→ 添加 `http://127.0.0.1:3080` |
| Edge | `edge://settings/content/sound` → 「允许播放声音」→ 添加；或在 `edge://settings/content/mediaAutoplay` 里把「媒体自动播放」设为**允许**（这一条是全局放宽，所有网站都会自动放声，不如前两个精准） |

生效后硬刷新页面，播放时左下角的「🔊 打开声音」按钮**不再出现**，就是已经在自动带声播了
（地址要写全，别漏端口）。
- 点击画面 / 按 `Esc` 跳过，跳过后仍然走同一段淡出，不会硬切
- 每次客户端加载都会播（刷新页面也算）
- 播放期**不会**等待 DSH 的加载状态：播完就淡出，无论应用早就绪还是在加载

## 换成你自己的视频

```sh
node scripts/make-asset.mjs <你的母带.mp4> --height 1440 --crf 22
```

**片源自带的黑边要在这一步裁掉**，播放器再怎么 `object-fit` 也去不掉"画出来的黑边"。
先用 `ffmpeg -vf cropdetect=24:16:0 -f null -` 看出黑边高度，再传给 `--crop`：

```sh
node scripts/make-asset.mjs <你的母带.mp4> --crop 2560:1086:0:177 --crf 22
```

脚本用 devDependency `@ffmpeg-installer/ffmpeg`（纯 npm 包，国内镜像可装，不需要访问 GitHub）把母带转成
**H.264 + AAC + yuv420p + faststart** 的 mp4：浏览器与 Electron 都能直接播，
体积通常压到 5–10 MB。

也可以直接手工替换 `assets/hdd.mp4`，只要满足：

| 项 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| 容器/编码 | `.mp4`，**H.264 视频 + AAC 音频**（H.265/HEVC 在 Chromium 里多半放不出） |
| 体积 | 建议 ≤ 15 MB（这个文件要随包分发，别人下载的是它） |
| 时长 | 建议 ≤ 20 秒，且一定要能跳过 |
| 分辨率 | 1080p/1440p 都行，播放时按 `object-fit: contain` 等比铺满 |

## 兼容与限制

- 要求 **DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.1**（`package.json#dsh.engines`）：宿主半边依赖 `webserver/index-inject`
  的行渲染行为与 `webServer.register` 的原始 `(req, res)` 契约
- 只能在 **Web UI 加载之后**覆盖全屏，做不到早于 Electron 窗口首帧（窗口本身仍有一瞬间空白）
- 首帧是一块**纯色**（`#000000`），不是视频的第一帧画面——它只负责在插件求值前占住屏幕
- 网页版**不可能**自动播放还带声音：浏览器拦未静音自动播放，只能静音起步、点一下开声
- 视频文件随包走（不是内联 base64），由宿主路由流式返回，支持 Range / 206 / 304

## 素材与许可

**代码 MIT。**

**内置素材分两段，授权状态不同，发布包只带第一段：**

| 素材 | 来源 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| `assets/hdd.mp4`（HDD 开机动画） | B 站 UP 主 **[@露霁luki_yo](https://space.bilibili.com/3537104783018790)** 的《Hollow Deep Dive System》(HDD) | ✅ **已获作者授权**，可随包分发 |
| `assets/yuedu.mp4`（欢迎来到月读世界） | 从电影片段剪出的几秒 | ⛔ **未获授权**——只在本机自用，**不进发布包** |

所以对外发布的那份只有 HDD 一段（用 `npm run pack:release` 打，见下）。
`yuedu.mp4` 不在仓库里，你自己那份请保留在 `assets/`，本地两段都能用。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [视频开屏方案.md](../视频开屏方案.md) | 立项方案：路线对比、素材实测、限制清单（本机文档，不在仓库内） |
| [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) | 版本记录 |

## 致谢

- **HDD 开机动画素材由 B 站 UP 主 [@露霁luki_yo](https://space.bilibili.com/3537104783018790) 授权提供**——
  《Hollow Deep Dive System》(HDD) 是他的作品，插件内置的那段片头就是它（压缩与裁边见 `scripts/make-asset.mjs`）。
- 首帧抢屏与"盖住开机卡片"的做法，最初由 [dsh-550c-boot](https://github.com/yannicksong0106/dsh-550c-boot)
  （Ziyang Song / Voidpoket）验证并记录；本插件沿用同一套宿主契约。

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Manually resume an interrupted DSH conversation: /continue and an action-row action pick the run up exactly where it stopped.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-continuechat

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Manually resume an interrupted DeepSeek Harness conversation.

When a turn ends early — stopped by hand, cut short by a failed model request, or truncated by the output-token limit — the harness leaves nothing behind but a "stopped" marker. This plugin adds the missing step: a `/continue` command and a **Continue** action in the action row under the interrupted reply itself, so the run picks up exactly where it stopped instead of restarting.

## What it solves

| Situation | Without the plugin | With the plugin |
|---|---|---|
| You hit stop by accident | Retype "continue" yourself | Click **Continue** |
| A network or provider failure aborted the turn | Restate the context before the model resumes | The plugin hands the recorded failure to the model and resumes |
| The reply was cut off by the token limit | The harness says *send "continue"* — with no entry point | One click or one command continues the answer |

## Usage

### Command

```
/continue
/continue also fix the remaining three files
```

Text after the command name is appended to the continuation prompt as an "Additional instruction from the user" line.

The command's outcome (`已请求继续对话（中断原因：手动停止）。`) is rendered by the harness command plane; it never becomes a model message.

### Button

On the turn that was cut short, a **Continue** action appears in the action row under the closing assistant message — the same row that carries copy / thumbs-up / thumbs-down / branch:

- **It only appears on a real interruption.** Turns that completed, were blocked, or merely closed a fork show nothing, so the button never shows up under a conversation that ended normally.
- Only the assistant message that closes that turn carries it; every other message renders nothing and takes no space.
- It disappears again once the agent is running.
- Clicking it is exactly one `/continue` execution.
- A failed attempt keeps a short error line next to the action (hover for the full text).

The decision comes from the session's durable event window: the newest `turn/end` must have a resumable reason *and* that turn must carry a **persistent** assistant message. A turn that was interrupted **before producing any assistant output** (a request that failed outright, a process that died before streaming) therefore has nowhere to host the button — use the `/continue` command there.

### Command menu

Type `/` and pick `continue` ("Continue the interrupted conversation from where it stopped"). Arrow keys plus Enter are enough — no draft typing required.

## How it works

### Interruption tracking (host half)

The plugin subscribes to the session log's `session/event` and tracks every turn end:

| `reason.kind` | Meaning | Resumable |
|---|---|---|
| `aborted` | Run cancelled. `reason.reason.kind` refines it: `user` stopped by hand, `parent` stopped by a parent operation, `hook` stopped by a harness hook, `disposed` session torn down | ✅ |
| `error` | Model request failed (network, auth, server) | ✅ |
| `max-tokens` | Reply truncated by the output-token limit (not a context-window overflow) | ✅ |
| `interrupted` | Turn closed by crash recovery after the host process was interrupted | ✅ |
| `completed` | Finished normally | ❌ |
| `blocked` | Step refused by `agent/pre-step` before entering | ❌ |
| `forked` | Fork seed closing an inherited prefix (the start of a new session) | ❌ |

Any later `user/message` clears the record — either the user took over, or the plugin already resumed the run.

### The continuation prompt

`/continue` does not send a bare "continue". It queues a structured user message:

```
<continue-conversation>
The previous turn ended early: the run was stopped by hand.
Continue the interrupted work in this same session, from exactly where it stopped:
- Do not restart the task, re-summarize, or repeat output and work that is already visible above.
- Treat the current workspace, tool results, and durable session state as authoritative; …
- If a tool call was interrupted, verify its outcome before retrying it, and never blindly retry an operation that may have side effects.
- Finish the remaining work, then verify the result before reporting it.
Failure recorded by the harness: <what the harness logged when the turn died>
Additional instruction from the user: <text typed after the command>
</continue-conversation>
```

The first line is rewritten per reason (stopped by hand / request failed / reply cut off / crash recovery), and the harness-recorded failure text is attached so the model knows *why* the turn ended — which is what decides between continuing to write and re-checking an interrupted tool call first.

### Why the answer is a separate message

After you press **Continue**, DSH opens a new turn for the model to write on, and the plugin then retires that turn's trigger prompt from the transcript — so you no longer see the prompt, and the interrupted reply is followed directly by the new text.

The retirement is a `system/message` replacement, and the log makes such an event *step-scoped*: its `turn`/`step` must name the step that is open as it lands, and both coordinates must be positive (`dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4/lib/index.js`, `assertV4SystemMessageFields` plus the relationship replay). A turn that has already ended names no open step, so the replacement cannot be written there. It rides the step that produced the model's answer to the prompt — or, for a turn that produced none, the next step that opens.

The new text **cannot be merged into the original message**. That is an architectural constraint of the DSH session log, not an implementation shortcut:

- The log is event-sourced: a committed assistant message cannot be edited, only shadowed by a surface `replace`.
- A `replace` must list every shadowed node in `sourceEventSeqs` (`dsh-session/lib/index.js:327`), while `assistant/message` is explicitly forbidden from carrying that field (`:313`, it embeds its provider stream). The two rules conflict, so no assistant event can perform a replacement.
- Shadowing the whole range with a `system/message` instead would also shadow the `tool/call` / `tool/result` pairs inside it, breaking the model history so the next request fails.

The provider side has no assistant prefill either (`dsh-llm-deepseek` carries only anthropic-beta flags), so the model cannot literally continue the previous assistant message — it must generate a new one.

The result: **no stray "continue" prompt, but still a separate new answer.**

### Message shape

The continuation message is built by hand as `{ id, role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text }], source: { kind: 'continue-chat' } }` and frozen:

- **The `id` is mandatory.** `Agent.inbox` deduplicates pending messages by `message.id` (a duplicate throws `already pending`) and never mints one, so the plugin generates it with `randomUUID()` from `node:crypto`.
- **`source.kind` is `continue-chat`.** Chat classifies a `user/message` by its source kind: `user` would render the prompt as a human bubble, while any other kind renders it as an injected-context node — and a context node whose content is plain text stays out of the visible node set. Never use `'plugin'` either: that is only the legacy format-v3 shape and format v4 rejects it when reading a log back.
- As a result the host half imports **nothing but `node:crypto`**: no `peerDependencies`, and therefore no exposure to the plugin version-compatibility gate.

### The browser half

The client half does exactly two things:

1. Registers the `continue-chat` dictionaries (zh/en).
2. Registers one action in the `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` slot. That slot's owner prop is `messageId` and its entries render inside Chat's `MessageIconActions` — the very component that owns copy / rating / branch — so the button lands in that row by construction.

Clicking it runs `ctx.remote.commands.execute(sessionId, '/continue', [])`, the same path a hand-typed `/continue` takes, so command lifecycle records, result rendering, and logging all stay identical.

Whether a message belongs to an interrupted turn is answered by the session's own durable event window: `ctx.s

# dsh-hard-delete

> **仓库**：<https://github.com/qwe4888789/dsh-hard-delete>
> **许可**：AGPL-3.0-only（+ 商业授权，见第九节） ｜ **版本**：v0.1.0 ｜ **类型**：cordis 插件（host + client 双半，零运行时依赖）

在 DSH 的侧边栏会话「…」菜单里加一行 **删除** —— 点一下就把这个会话**彻底删掉**：

- **不可恢复**：直接物理删除，不进回收站、没有回滚。
- **不设门槛**：不看「疑似还在活动」，不要求二次输入，只弹一次确认框（因为不可逆）。
- **当前会话也能删**：确认框会明确提示「这正是你当前打开的会话，删完请切换或刷新」。
- **删完整**：会话目录之外，还清掉指向它的 projcache 条目与 `workspace.json` 引用，
  避免留下悬空元数据。

> 与同机另一个插件 **`dsh-session-recycle`** 的分工：
> 那个是设置页里的「软删 → 回收站 → 恢复 / 回滚」，保守、可救回；
> 这个是菜单里的一键硬删。两者互不干扰（本插件不碰 `_recycle-bin/`）。

---

## 一、形态与注册

本插件**同时**声明 `dsh.bundle` 与 `dsh.client`，因此走 **bundle 层**注册：

```json
"dsh": {
  "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" },
  "client": { "inject": [], "platform": "web" }
}
```

> `dsh.client.inject` 刻意留空：本插件浏览器半只 `require("react")`（平台种子词）。
> 为什么不去 require 官方 UI 组件库，见第六节第 7 条。

> ⚠️ 只有 `dsh.client` 而**没有** `dsh.bundle` 的插件不能进 `dsh.profile.bundles` ——
> 宿主会以 `declares no dsh.bundle` 拒绝并**启动即崩**。本插件两个都声明了，所以不受此限。

装到某个 profile：

```bash
# 方式 A（推荐）：让 DSH 自己装 —— 桌面端「插件 → 添加插件」里粘贴本仓地址，
#   或命令行（profile 名按你的实际环境改）：
dsh plugin --profile web add qwe4888789/dsh-hard-delete

# 方式 B：声明式手工安装
#   在 <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<name>/package.json 里
#     dependencies:        { "dsh-hard-delete": "link:<本仓路径>" }
#     dsh.profile.bundles: 追加 "dsh-hard-delete"
cd <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<name> && pnpm install
# 重启 DSH
```

> 桌面版（DeepSeek Harness 桌面端）的 `desktop` profile 由 Electron 应用独占，
> 别用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop …`（CLI 会直接拒绝）；桌面端请走「插件 → 添加插件」。

---

## 二、两个槽位

| 槽位 | 挂什么 | 为什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` | 菜单里的「删除」行（id `hard-delete`，order **500**，排在 archive 的 400 之后） | owner 注入 `{ sessionId, displayTitle }` 与 `useMenuOpenState` 钩子 |
| `shell.overlay` | 确认框 + 结果提示 | **必须挂在常驻浮层上**：确认框若挂在菜单项里，菜单一关它就跟着卸载了 |

菜单项只做一件事：把「待确认请求」写进模块级小 store，然后关掉菜单。
浮层里的对话框读同一个 store，所以在菜单卸载后依然活着。

界面**自绘**（官方 `MenuItemButton` / `Modal` / `Button` / `Toast` 拿不到，见第六节第 7 条），
但完全照官方 `Menu.module.css` 的规格来：`min-height:34px` / `padding:6px 8px` /
`gap:6px` / `border-radius: var(--dsw-radius-md)` / hover 用
`--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover`，危险行用 `--dsw-alias-state-error-primary` +
`--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover-danger`。DOM 也与官方同构：
`div > [role=separator] + button[role=menuitem]` —— 菜单的键盘遍历与焦点回收都是读 DOM 的，
自绘按钮同样能参与。每个 `var()` 都写了兜底值，主题变量缺失时不会变成透明。

---

## 三、host 半的路由

前缀可配（默认 `/api/dsh-hard-delete`），全部 **loopback-only + same-origin 校验**。

| 方法 | 路径 | 请求体 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/config` | — | 公开配置（`apiPrefix` / 文案覆盖 / 开关 / `configErrors`），**不含绝对路径** |
| POST | `/inspect` | `{sessionId}` | 一个会话的概况：标题 / 工作目录 / 大小 / 文件数 / 有无线索日志 |
| POST | `/delete` | `{sessionId, confirm:true}` | **彻底删除**（不可逆） |

错误统一 `{ error, code }`。值得注意的 code：`session-not-found`(404)、
`confirm-required`(400)、`invalid-sessionId`(400)、`path-escape`(400)、
`loopback-only`(403)、`body-too-large`(413)。

返回列表里**不含任何绝对路径**——界面只显示标题 / 工作目录 / 大小 / 文件数。

---

## 四、删一个会话要动几处

```
<DSH_HOME>/
├─ sessions/<projectKey>/<sessionId>/
│  └─ session[.v<N>].jsonl[.zstd]        ← ① 整个目录物理删除（多版本日志一起）
├─ storages/
│  ├─ session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json  ← ② 新版：每会话一个文件
│  ├─ session_projcache.json                ← ③ 旧版：tables.sessions[<id>]
│  └─ workspace.json                        ← ④ archivedSessionIds / pinnedSessionIds
│                                              / tables.workspaces[*].sessionIds
└─ （浏览器那一边）
   └─ ctx.emit('api-session/removed', id)   ← ⑤ 让侧边栏那一行立刻消失
```

安全性质：

- **路径纵深防御**：`sessionId` 必须是单层路径段（挡 `.` / `..` / 分隔符 / NUL），
  定位后再用 `relative()` 确认最终目录没跑出 `sessions/`。
- **只认精确路径**：只在 `sessions/<任意项目目录>/<精确的 sessionId>` 下动手，
  绝不复刻宿主的目录名编码规则（也就不会被规则变化带偏）。
- **不覆盖、不猜**：定位不到就是 404，什么都不做。
- **元数据清理失败不冒充删除失败**：降级成 `warnings` 如实回传，界面照实提示。
- **原子写 JSON**：先写 `.tmp-<pid>-<ts>` 再 rename，网络盘上失败也不留半个文件。
- **只读探测**：`/inspect` 全程不写盘。

---

## 五、七个实测踩出来的坑（本节是这份代码最有价值的部分）

1. **多帧 zstd：Node 的同步接口只解第一帧。** DSH 的会话日志是**多帧拼接**的。
   `zstdDecompressSync(整个文件)` 实测在 107 KB 的文件上只吐 187 字节（就第一帧），
   `zlib.createZstdDecompress()` 流也一样停在第一帧。必须按 magic `28 B5 2F FD`
   切帧、逐帧解。第一版没做这件事，标题/工作目录大面积读不出来。

2. **头部解码要「帧数 + 字节」双限。** 帧大小不固定（实测 1.5 KB ~ 35 KB 都有），
   只限帧数会漏后文，只限字节会白解一堆帧。两个都设，取先到的那个；
   并且 magic 也可能出现在压缩数据内部，解不开就跳过，靠 JSON 解析兜住误判。

3. **projcache 有两种布局，都得清。** 实测 `<home>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`
   与 `<home>/storages/session_projcache.json` 的 `tables.sessions[<id>]` 同时存在。
   只清一种就会留下悬空条目。

4. **存在「空壳」会话目录。** 真实 `~/.dsh` 里有目录建了但没写成日志的会话
   （实测 15 个会话目录里有 1 个）。如果「必须扫到日志才算会话」，
   这类目录就永远删不掉。改成：**目录名精确等于 sessionId 就认**，
   日志有无只作为 `hasLog` 事实回传。

5. **侧边栏那一行不会自己消失 —— 但有一条现成的事件。**
   客户端 `ctx.sessions`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` 的 client 半）
   通过 `ctx.remote.$on('api-session/added' | 'api-session/removed', …)` 维护会话列表；
   宿主侧 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes` 把这批宿主 Cordis 事件原样转发给浏览器。
   所以删完文件只要 `ctx.emit('api-session/removed', sessionId)`，那一行立刻消失，
   不必等下一次 list 刷新，也不必自己去动客户端的列表状态。

6. **删除当前会话受 Windows 文件语义影响。** 宿主对日志文件是**持有句柄持续追加写**的。
   Node/libuv 打开文件时带 `FILE_SHARE_DELETE`，所以删除通常能成功（名字立刻消失），
   但宿主后台仍可能在写那个已经 unlink 的文件。因此确认框里明确写了
   「若它正在运行，建议删完重启一次 DSH」。

7. **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 在浏览器里 require 不到。**
   浏览器端模块表里只有两类东西：平台种子词（react 一族）和**声明了 `dsh.client`
   的 Loader 条目**。primitives 两个都不是 —— 它没有 `dsh.client`，在插件树里也没有
   对应条目（实测 201 条 Loader 条目里没有它）；官方客户端插件是在**构建期**把它内联
   进自己 bundle 的。所以第三方插件要么自己上构建，要么自己画。本插件选择自己画，
   但严格照官方 `Menu.module.css` 的规格与主题变量来（见第二节）。
   推论：`dsh.client.inject` 里写一个不存在的包名不会报错（只是解析不到），
   真正会炸的是运行时的 `require` —— 所以本插件只 `require("react")`。

---

## 六、配置

`<DSH_HOME>/hard-delete.config.json`（可选；env 优先）。载入一次常驻，改完**重启 DSH** 生效。

```json
{
  "apiPrefix": "/api/dsh-hard-delete",
  "cleanMetadata": true,
  "emitRemovedEvent": true,
  "maxFiles": 20000,
  "headerFrames": 32,
  "headerScanBytes": 262144,
  "text": {}
}
```

env 覆盖：`DSH_HOME`、`HARD_DELETE_CONFIG`、`HARD_DELETE_API_PREFIX`。

`text` 段可按 key 覆盖界面文案（前端内置 zh 字典兜底；默认下发空表 = 不覆盖）。
`cleanMetadata:false` = 只删会话目录，留元数据；`emitRemovedEvent:false` = 不发那一行消失事件。

---

## 七、测试

```bash
node _test/test-host.mjs           # 39 项夹具断言，全在临时目录里跑，不碰真实会话
node _test/test-client.mjs         # 11 项客户端离线断言（最小 hooks 运行时跑一遍渲染）
node _test/smoke-real-readonly.mjs # 对真实 ~/.dsh 只读冒烟（不做任何写操作）
node _test/verify-e2e-copy.mjs     # 把真实 home 复制一份，走完整 HTTP 栈删一个真会话
```

夹具单测覆盖：多项目定位、版本号文件名、多帧 zstd 头部解码、两种 projcache 布局、
空壳目录、路径穿越、dryRun、workspace.json 引用清理、删除后 404、
loopback / Host / 跨站 / 跨源 / 405 / 非法 JSON / 413 / `confirm` 校验 /
`api-session/removed` 的发出与关闭开关。

客户端离线单测覆盖：factory 形态、**只 require `react`**、两个槽位的 id/order/locale、
文案 key 全部有兜底、菜单项 DOM 与官方同构且点击后关菜单并写入请求、
确认框三条警告齐全且默认焦点在「取消」、缺 slots API 时明确报错、
sessions 服务取不到时降级不炸。

`verify-e2e-copy.mjs` 是最后一道闸：真实会话目录里的多版本日志、真实 projcache
与 workspace.json，走完整链路删掉一个真会话后逐项核对，**真实库全程只读**。

---

## 八、明确不做的事（以及为什么）

- **不做回收站 / 回滚**：本插件就是「删掉」这一个动作。要可恢复请用 `dsh-session-recycle`。
- **不做活动守卫**：用户要的是「自由删除」，加守卫就回到了软删插件的语义。
  取而代之的是确认框里把风险讲清楚（不可恢复 / 当前会话 / 可能仍在写盘）。
- **不改主包的会话列表状态**：只发一个宿主事件，列表由客户端自己维护。
- **不碰宿主服务**：只 `inject: ['webServer']`，不 import 会话/工作区服务。
- **不返回绝对路径**：前端显示不了也不需要。

---

## 九、许可

**AGPL-3.0-only**（GNU Affero General Public License v3.0），全文见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

本项目管理在 **AGPL-3.0** 下开放：个人、学习、开源项目可自由使用与修改。
若需在 **闭源** 或 **商业场景** 中使用（不愿承接 AGPL 的传染条款），请联系获取**商业授权** ——
本仓暂无公开的联系邮箱，**请通过本仓 Issue 联系**。

本仓自 v0.1.0 起即为 AGPL-3.0，尚无许可变更历史。

本仓代码为**独立实现**：实现时观察了宿主公开的运行时约定（HTTP 路由注册方式 `ctx.webServer.register`、
客户端打包形态 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`、槽位注册 `ctx.slots.inject/register`、
磁盘布局与日志文件名、转发事件 allowlist）与官方 `Menu.module.css` 的公开样式规格；
**未复制任何第三方插件代码**。命名上刻意避开 npm 上已被占用的 `dsh-session-delete` / `dsh-session-recycle`。

---

## 十、发布与收录

- 发布流程、版本号策略与推送步骤见 [docs/RELEASING.md](docs/RELEASING.md)；
  推送脚本 [scripts/push-publish.mjs](scripts/push-publish.mjs)（token 只从环境变量读，不落盘、不进 git 配置）。
- **远端只有 GitHub**：插件市场按 GitHub 仓库索引，Gitee 镜像对本仓没有收益，故不做。
- **插件市场收录**：[dshbase](https://dshbase.com/) 与 [DSH 插件市场](https://github.com/bradeGithub/DSH-Plugins-Marketplace)
  按 GitHub 仓库的 **`dsh-plugin` topic 自动索引**（每 2 小时扫一次）。本仓的 topic：
  `dsh-plugin` · `dsh` · `deepseek-harness` · `cordis-plugin`。
- 市场按 `package.json` 的 `version` 判断更新；**发版必须 bump version**（见 CHANGELOG）。

plugins.description: Host-level knowledge vault access with zero-config discovery, 3 retrieval tools, and destructive command safety guard for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
**Give your DeepSeek Harness agent a brain — host-level knowledge access, zero-config vault discovery, and a safety guard for destructive shell commands.** **ต่อสมองให้เอเจนต์ DeepSeek Harness — เข้าถึงคลังความรู้ระดับ host, ค้นหา vault อัตโนมัติแบบไม่ต้องตั้งค่า, และกันคำสั่ง shell ที่ทำลายข้อมูล** [![CI](https://github.com/Babydunx1/dsh-knowledge-bridge/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Babydunx1/dsh-knowledge-bridge/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Dependencies: 0](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-success.svg)](package.json) [![Tests: 28 passing](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-28%20passing-brightgreen.svg)](#development) [![Bundle contract: 21 checks](https://img.shields.io/badge/bundle%20contract-21%20checks-blueviolet.svg)](#development) [![Platform: Windows · macOS · Linux](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%C2%B7%20macOS%20%C2%B7%20Linux-lightgrey.svg)](#installation) **English** · [ภาษาไทย](#-ภาษาไทย)
---
### Architecture at a glance · ภาพรวมสถาปัตยกรรม ```mermaid flowchart LR V[("Knowledge vault
50 items · 229 files")] D["Discovery
env var → ~ → ./"] I["Index
id · title · summary · artifacts"] T["Tools
search · read · list"] A["Agent context"] Q["One-line directive
~140 chars"] G{"Safety guard
exec.name + exec.arguments"} V --> D --> I --> T --> A Q --> A A --> G G -->|"banned pattern"| X["Denied ❌"] G -->|"clean"| R["Executed ✅"] ```
---
### Try it in 10 seconds · ลองใช้ใน 10 วินาที ```bash git clone https://github.com/Babydunx1/dsh-knowledge-bridge && cd dsh-knowledge-bridge npm test # 28 tests — unit + bundle contract, no install needed npm run validate # 21 static checks on the bundle contract npm run demo # index a sample vault and print what the agent would see ``` ```text 2 · index 2 item(s) · 3 artifact(s) ├─ deploy-guide · 1 artifact(s) └─ posttracker_engine · 2 artifact(s) 4 · guard (patterns are matched against the command string) ⛔ BLOCKED git reset --hard HEAD~1 ⛔ BLOCKED rm -rf / ✅ allowed git status ``` No install, no configuration, no DeepSeek Harness required. ไม่ต้องติดตั้ง ไม่ต้องตั้งค่า ไม่ต้องเปิด DeepSeek Harness ก็ลองได้
--- ## 🇬🇧 English ### Why this exists An agent's quality is bounded by what it can *reach*, not by how smart it is. Three concrete failure modes motivated this plugin: 1. **Sandbox false negatives.** Under `workspace-write`, an agent cannot read knowledge vaults or repositories outside the active workspace. On Windows the shell turns that denial into a misleading `File Not Found`, so the agent concludes the knowledge does not exist — and starts guessing. 2. **Context amnesia.** Teams keep 50+ architecture docs, SOPs and API contracts in a vault (Antigravity's `~/.gemini/antigravity-ide/knowledge`, shared drives, `docs/`). DeepSeek Harness has no native way to discover or index them. 3. **Irreversible commands.** Autonomous agents happily run `git reset --hard`, `git clean -fd` or `git restore .` and destroy uncommitted work. `dsh-knowledge-bridge` runs as a **host-level cordis plugin**: it reads the host filesystem with the host process's own permissions, exposes three fast retrieval tools, injects a one-line directive so the model knows a vault exists, and denies destructive shell calls before they execute. ### Goals | Goal | How it is met | |---|---| | **Scoped, on-demand knowledge** | Nothing is dumped into the prompt. One ~140-character directive is injected; content is pulled per topic — `knowledge_search` → `knowledge_read`. | | **Zero configuration** | The vault is auto-discovered from an environment variable or well-known locations. No hardcoded paths anywhere in the code. | | **Zero dependencies** | Node.js built-ins only (`node:fs`, `node:path`, `node:os`). Nothing to install. | | **Never destroy user work** | A monotonic guard: any matching rule denies the call, and no other plugin can force-allow it. | | **Portable** | `~`-relative discovery, `DSH_KNOWLEDGE_PATHS` override, works with any markdown vault layout. | #### What this plugin is *not* - It is **not** a memory system that loads your whole vault into every prompt. A 2 MB vault is ~1M tokens: slow and expensive. - It is **not** a vector database. Ranking is deterministic keyword scoring — predictable, debuggable, no embedding service to run. ### Features | | Feature | Detail | |---|---|---| | 🧠 | `knowledge_search` | Keyword search with explicit weights: title 10 · id 8 · **aliases 8** · **tags 6** · **references 4** · summary 3 · artifact name 2 · **document body 1** (lazy, cached by mtime). Returns `id`, `title`, `score`, a clipped summary and the artifact list — never file content. | | 📖 | `knowledge_read` | Reads a full document, or one specific artifact (`master_guide.md`, `07_migration.md`, …) on demand. | | 🗂️ | `knowledge_list` | The vault outline: ids, titles, artifact counts, one-line previews. | | ℹ️ | `knowledge_info` | Installed version, the exact update command for **this** profile, the restart requirement, and — on demand — whether a newer version is published. The registry lookup never runs at load, and an unreadable registry answers `null`, never a false "up to date". | | 🔎 | Zero-config discovery | `DSH_KNOWLEDGE_PATHS` → `~/.gemini/antigravity-ide/knowledge` → `~/.antigravity-ide/knowledge` → `~/.dsh/knowledge` → `~/.codex/knowledge` → `./knowledge` → `./docs/knowledge` → `./.knowledge`. | | 📜 | Rules injection | Discovers `AGENTS.md` / `GEMINI.md` / `CLAUDE.md` from the workspace and adds them to the system prompt. | | 🛑 | Safety guard | Denies `bash` / `pwsh` / `cmd` / `terminal` calls whose command matches a banned pattern. | | 🪶 | Token-aware | Tool summaries are clipped, because tool output is replayed in every later model call. | ### Installation
Option A — Add plugin: paste the link (recommended, ~1 minute) 1. DeepSeek Harness → **Plugins** → **Add plugin** 2. Paste this address into **Package name or address**: ```text https://github.com/Babydunx1/dsh-knowledge-bridge ``` 3. Click **Install**, then **restart DeepSeek Harness** (a restart loads a fresh JavaScript module generation) Accepted addresses — all of these pass DSH's own check: | Paste this | Kind | |:--|:--| | `https://github.com/Babydunx1/dsh-knowledge-bridge` | Git repository (recommended) | | `github:Babydunx1/dsh-knowledge-bridge` | Git shorthand | | `https://github.com/Babydunx1/dsh-knowledge-bridge#v1.0.0` | Git, pinned to a tag / branch / commit (`#main`, `#semver:^1.0.0`) | | `https://github.com/Babydunx1/dsh-knowledge-bridge/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz` | Tarball — use this when Git is not installed on the machine | | `git@github.com:Babydunx1/dsh-knowledge-bridge.git` | Git over SSH | A GitHub **page** URL with extra path segments (e.g. `.../tree/main`) is refused with *"a URL must point at a git repository or a tarball"*. Command-line equivalent (same code path as the dialog): ```bash dsh plugin --profile add https://github.com/Babydunx1/dsh-knowledge-bridge ``` #### 🔁 Updating — just ask your agent DSH has no plugin auto-update yet, and you do not need to learn a command. Tell your agent: > “Update the `dsh-knowledge-bridge` plugin, then tell me what to restart.” The plugin writes the exact command for this profile into the agent's prompt (`knowledge_info` returns it too), so the agent can run it for you. When the host cannot see the profile name, it writes the shell form instead — `$env:DSH_PROFILE` on Windows, `"$DSH_PROFILE"` elsewhere — which the DSH shell resolves for itself: ```bash dsh plugin --profile update dsh-knowledge-bridge # or: Plugins → uninstall → Add plugin again ``` Then **restart DeepSeek Harness** — the new code loads on the n

# 深鲸画布 · DSH 插件

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-shell-canvas)

把一段文字，变成能发的视频。

贴一段稿子、选几张素材，点一下出横竖双版成片。
**稿子、素材、成片都在你自己的电脑上** —— 不上传、不联网，拔掉网线照样出片。

## 安装

在你所用的、支持 DSH 的载体里打开「插件管理器」，选择**从压缩包安装**，选中下载好的 `.tgz` 即可。

命令行安装：

```bash
# 推荐：从 npm 装（始终取最新版，不钉版本号）
dsh plugin add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-shell-canvas
```

也可以从官网下载插件包后，在插件管理器里「从压缩包安装」：
<https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/download.html>


装完无需重启，界面跟随所在载体的外观。

## 能力

- **一次出三种版式** —— 旁白口播 / 金句引用 / 步骤清单，编排各不相同
- **逐句指定配图** —— 分镜表里逐句安排素材与时长，素材与字幕一一对应
- **一个位置放多张图或一段视频** —— 多图按时间轮播；视频素材会让画面真的动起来
- **每个镜头换版位** —— 尺寸、位置、入场方式逐镜轮换
- **一次出横竖双版** —— 同一份稿子，横版竖版一起给
- **模型不绑任何一家** —— 生图与配音接你自己的接口，密钥留在本机
- **批量出片** —— 一次丢进一整批；一条出错不拖垮整批
- **跨平台** —— macOS / Windows / Linux

## 授权

| | |
|---|---|
| **免费版** | **不限条数**出片，成片带水印，直接下载就能用，不用注册 |
| **授权版** | ¥199/年，去掉水印 + 批量出片 + 每条可查 |

有效期 1 年，期间不限出片次数。授权码按时间到期，**不绑机器**。

## 平台

装在任意支持 DSH 的载体上，**不绑定桌面端**。

# dsh-flash

> Quick Control panel **core** for the DSH web UI — the floating/docked quick-control panel with an **extensible switch registry** other plugins register their own controls into, the skin system, zh/en i18n and the alert surfaces. The DSH **Workbench** (dock-base) integration ships separately as the `dock-flash` adapter.

**[中文文档](./README.zh-CN.md)**

## Core + adapter

This package is the **panel** and nothing else. It owns the React panel, the `quickControl` switch registry, the skin system, the alert surfaces, the standalone floating ⚡ trigger, and the whole host half (`src/index.ts` → `dist/index.js`). It has **no dependency on dock-base at all**, so it runs on its own, and it *always* offers the panel and the ⚡ trigger. A dock host takes the panel by claiming the `dockFlashPanel` service; only then does the core stand its own ⚡ down.

The dock-base (Workbench) integration is a separate, thin **adapter** package — `dock-flash` v3 — that depends on this one and registers the panel, the plugin card, the activity-bar item, the editor view and the command through `ctx.workbench`.

```
dsh-flash ──provides "dockFlashPanel"──▶ dock-flash ──ctx.workbench──▶ dock-base Workbench
   this package: panel, switch              the adapter: 5 registrations
   registry, skins, i18n, alerts,           + the claim/release handshake
   standalone ⚡, host routes
```

The dependency arrow points **one way**: this package never imports or names `dock-flash`. It publishes the service and stands its own ⚡ down when a host claims it; whoever claims it is a stranger it does not have to know about. That is what lets the panel work both standalone and under dock-base from one build, and why the core can be installed on a profile that has no dock-base at all.

| What you want | Install | You get |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Workbench (dock-base) integration | `dock-flash@^3`, which pulls this package in — plus `dock-base` | Sidebar/floating panel, plugin card, activity-bar ⚡, editor view, the `dock-flash:openQuickControl` command |
| Only the standalone floating ⚡ | `dsh-flash` alone | A ⚡ trigger in the configured conversation slot → floating panel |

### Upgrading from `dock-flash` v2

Nothing breaks by default. Your `^2.x` dependency range keeps you on the **old single package**, which still exists under the same name — the split added a new major (`dock-flash@^3`) rather than replacing v2. To move to the split, install `dock-flash@^3`; it depends on this package and pulls it in.

> **One profile edit is required, and it is easy to miss.** In the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` the entry that carries your panel settings reads `- id: dock-flash` / `name: dock-flash`. That `name:` is an *assertion* about the target row's current specifier, not a rename. After the split, `id: dock-flash` resolves to **this** core row, whose specifier is `dsh-flash`, so the assertion mismatches, DSH prints ``patch: name mismatch for "dock-flash" (expected "dsh-flash", got "dock-flash"), skipping`` and the whole `config:` block is **dropped** — silently reverting your panel order, your skin and your trigger position/size. Change that entry's `name: dock-flash` to `name: dsh-flash` and keep `id: dock-flash`.

> **The settings namespace itself does not change.** The profile patch **entry id** deliberately stays `dock-flash`, because that entry id *is* the settings namespace every already-published user preference lives under. The settings section, the persisted `dock-flash:…` keys and the `/plugins/dock-flash/…` host routes are all unchanged across the split — the `name:` fix above is the only edit the upgrade needs.

## Modes

| Mode | Condition | UI | Available switches |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Claimed** (Workbench) | the `dock-flash` adapter (and dock-base) installed | ⚡ in the activity bar → sidebar/floating panel; the core's standalone ⚡ is suppressed while the panel is claimed | Appearance + System |
| **Standalone** | `dsh-flash` installed alone | ⚡ trigger in the configured conversation slot → floating panel | Appearance + Layout + System |

## Features

### Built-in switches

Built-in switches are grouped into Appearance / Layout / System (compact two-column layout). The Layout group is offered in standalone mode only:

| Group | Switch | Type | Description | Standalone |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 🎨 Appearance | Theme | select | Lists what the theme service publishes, minus the dead options. While a theme publishes its **own palette** (Dream: Abyss / Aurora / …), those palettes are the list and Light / Dark / System are withheld — the palette paints over the base scheme and fixes its own colour scheme, so none of the three could do anything. With no palette published — no skin installed, **or a restyling skin such as Claude** — the list is Light / Dark / System, and Follow-system really does resolve against the OS | ✅ |
| 🎨 Appearance | Skin | select | Dynamically discovers installed skin plugins and switches between them, through DSH's **own plugin manager** — dsh-market is neither needed nor consulted. Every switch writes BOTH layers: the loader ENTRY row (what the running page acts on) and `dsh.profile.bundles` (what the next boot composes), because writing only one of them is how a skin came back after a reload, or could never be switched on again | ✅ |
| 🎨 Appearance | Turn Rail | toggle | Moves DSH's built-in turn navigator from the right gutter to the left. Hidden unless DSH's own rail is on screen and no other timeline plugin owns it | ✅ |
| 🎨 Appearance | Fullscreen | toggle | Browser Fullscreen API — enter/exit fullscreen | ✅ |
| 🎨 Appearance | Log Download | toggle | Show/hide the session log download button | ✅ |
| 📐 Layout | Close on Blur | buttongroup | Off / On — auto-close the panel when clicking outside. Also a toggle in the panel header (both modes) | ✅ |
| 📐 Layout | Trigger Position | select | Input Left / Input Right / Session Header / Header Utils — where the standalone ⚡ trigger goes — or **Conversation top-right**, a floating button inside the conversation you can drag anywhere within it | ✅ |
| 📐 Layout | Trigger Button Size | slider | 24–64 px — how big the standalone ⚡ entry point is drawn, glyph and corner radius included. The draggable **Conversation top-right** position allows the full range; the slot positions cap at **48px** so the button still fits the input row, and the row shows the size actually in force | ✅ |
| 🖱️ Right-click | *(the draggable ⚡ itself)* | menu | **Reset position** / current offset / version (click to copy a diagnostic) / **layer** and **rest opacity** presets. Not a switch in the panel: the layer and the opacity only apply to the floating button, and the menu deliberately does not repeat `trigger-size`, `trigger-position` or `close-on-blur` | ✅ |
| ⚙️ System | Language | buttongroup | 中文 / English — switches DSH global UI language | ✅ |
| ⚙️ System | Missing Companions | log | Names every companion plugin that is not **running**, splitting `installed, not running` from `not installed` — a package that is present but silent is a different problem from one that is absent. Read-only: it prints the `dsh plugin --profile <name> add …` command for the ones genuinely missing (and points at the DSH Plugins page on the reserved `desktop` profile, which the CLI refuses), plus a copy button. A ✕ hides both rows through the same visibility store the ◉ mode writes, so nothing is unregistered and ticking them again brings them back | ✅ |

> **The Layout group only renders in standalone mode.** When a host claims the panel, `close-on-blur` exists solely as the panel-header toggle, so no built-in switch carries `group: 'layout'` and the category is skipped entirely.

> **Dock layout is not configured here.** Dock edge, auto-hide, reserve space and icon scaling are dock-base's own settings — this package deliberately does not duplicate them. In the Layout group it owns only `trigger-position`, `trigger-size` and `close-on-blur`, all standalone-only.

> **Turn Rail only offers itself while DSH's own rail is what you see.** It stays hidden with no session open, in a session without turns, while DSH's own `@c

plugins.description: OpenCode Zen free models for DeepSeek Harness, with live catalog discovery and no dependencies.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zen-adapter

把 [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen) 的**免费模型**接入 DeepSeek Harness，
注册为原生 provider `zen-free`。

无需注册、无需 API key、无需额外进程。

[English](README.en.md) | 简体中文

---

## 特性

- **零配置** — 装上、重启、就能在模型选择器里选到免费模型
- **零依赖** — `dependencies` 为空，运行时复用 DSH 自带的 pi-ai，因此可以和其他
  provider 插件共存（详见[为什么零依赖很重要](#为什么零依赖很重要)）
- **动态模型目录** — 从上游实时发现，不是写死的清单，上游换模型不用等插件更新
- **可用性检测** — 区分「目录里在售」和「这台机器真的能调通」，避免选到用不了的模型
- **可视化面板** — 在插件详情页一键获取模型、检测可用性，并查看上下文大小

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:seonzzy/dsh-zen-adapter
# 或从本地目录安装：
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add <本目录绝对路径>
```

装完**重启 DSH**，然后在模型选择器里选择 **OpenCode Zen (free lane)** 分组下的模型。

### 前提条件

| 条件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH 版本 | 需要带 `llm.registerAdapter` 与 `webServer` 的版本 |
| Node | ≥ 20（DSH 自带，无需另装）|
| 网络 | 能访问 `opencode.ai` 与 `models.dev` |

不需要安装 pi-ai、不需要 API key、不需要 npm/pnpm 下载任何东西。

## 使用

### 模型选择器

安装后在对话输入框的模型选择器里会出现 **OpenCode Zen (free lane)** 分组，
选择其中一个模型即可开始对话。

目录会**动态获取**：启动时后台拉取，之后每 30 分钟自动刷新一次。

### 插件面板

在「设置 → 插件 → dsh-zen-adapter」页面上有一个面板：

| 按钮 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| **获取模型** | 从上游重新拉取模型目录 |
| **检测可用性** | 逐个真实请求，测出哪些模型当前可用 |

下面的表格展示：模型名、上下文大小、输出上限、可用状态、判定依据。

> **「目录里有」不等于「能用」。** 免费模型的实际可用性受上游端点状态、
> 地区限制、以及**按 IP 计的配额**影响，随时会变。建议在新环境里点一次
> 「检测可用性」。

## 模型是怎么来的

插件同时读取两个上游数据源，取交集：

| 源 | 提供 | 不提供 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opencode.ai/inference/v1/models` | 当前**在售**的模型 id | 价格、上下文 |
| `models.dev/api.json` | `cost`、`limit.context`、`limit.output` | 是否在售 |

第二个源是必需的——上游的 `/v1/models` 只返回 `{ id, object, created, owned_by }`，
**无法从它判断某模型是否免费**。

**免费判定**以 models.dev 的 `cost` 为准（`input` 与 `output` 均为 0）。
已弃用或收费的模型即使 id 带 `-free` 也不会放行——上游会把下架模型在目录里
继续挂一段时间。只有 metadata 缺失时（通常是刚发布的新模型）才退回看 `-free` 后缀。

上下文大小与输出上限同样来自 models.dev，所以界面上显示的是真实数值，
不是某个固定常数。

### 模型目录缓存

两个数据源的稳定性差别很大，因此缓存策略也不同：

| 数据 | 缓存时长 | 为什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 在售模型列表 | 5 分钟 | 新模型应该尽快出现在选择器里 |
| models.dev 价格与限额 | 24 小时 | 极少变动，一天内重算没有意义 |

缓存写在 `~/.cache/dsh-zen-adapter/catalog.db`（与 `dsh-free-search` 的位置约定一致），
删除该目录即可清空，没有后台任务残留。需要换位置时设置 `ZEN_CACHE_DIR` 环境变量。

这样做带来三个实际效果：

- **启动更快** —— 不再每次拉取 models.dev 那份覆盖所有 provider 的大文件
- **离线可用** —— 断网启动时仍能列出完整模型列表
- **「获取模型」仍然是真的刷新** —— 该按钮会绕过缓存真正请求上游，不会被缓存糊弄

## 为什么零依赖很重要

本插件**不声明任何 `dependencies`**，`@deepseek-ai/*` 与 `@earendil-works/pi-ai`
全部声明为 `peerDependencies` 且标记 `optional`。

原因：DSH 宿主自带一份 pi-ai，插件运行时沿宿主的模块树解析，全局始终只有一份。

如果插件自带一份 pi-ai，机器上就会出现**两个 pi-ai 世代**。这不只是冗余——
某些插件（例如 `dsh-workbuddy-xdpool`）会校验宿主与插件用的是不是同一世代，
不一致时整个 provider 每次调用都会失败。

因此本插件可以和其他 provider 插件**同时安装**。

## 上游限制

OpenCode 的免费通道**按 IP 计配额**，部分模型还有**地区限制**。

可能遇到的情况：

| 现象 | 原因 | 怎么办 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `429` | 配额用尽或请求过密 | 等一会儿再试，或换网络节点 |
| `403 RegionError` | 该模型不对你所在地区开放 | 无法绕过，换其他模型 |
| `5xx` / `400` | 上游端点暂时故障 | 换其他模型，稍后再试 |
| 模型不在选择器里 | 尚未被判定为免费 | 点「获取模型」刷新目录 |

这些都属于**上游侧**行为，插件无法修复。用「检测可用性」可以看到每个模型的
当前状态。

## 配置

本插件没有需要配置的选项。如需调整可选行为，可修改 `lib/index.js` 顶部的常量：

| 常量 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PROVIDER_ID` | `zen-free` | 在 DSH 中显示的 provider id |
| `SEED_MODELS` | 3 个模型 | 目录拉取完成前的占位列表 |
| 目录刷新间隔 | 30 分钟 | 见 `lib/index.js` 中的 `refreshTimer` |

## 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> remove dsh-zen-adapter
```

然后重启 DSH。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Native archived-session management for DeepSeek Harness with guarded permanent deletion and fixed batches.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Session Bin

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的原生归档管理插件。在一个面板中搜索、筛选和管理已归档会话，支持取消归档、单项永久删除、批量永久删除和清空归档。

插件直接管理 Harness 的原生 Archive 集合，已有归档也会显示。归档仍使用宿主的原生操作。

## 功能

- 默认按工作区分组；按会话名称及工作区元数据搜索、筛选。
- 单项或批量取消归档，让会话回到原生会话列表。
- 单项永久删除、固定选择的批量永久删除，以及清空点击时的全部归档。
- 简洁的删除确认，可在设置中全局关闭；批量操作显示进度和日志，完成后保留简短统计及失败项。中断或断线后可查询结果并明确继续。
- 中英文界面，使用宿主控件、浅色和深色主题。

当前版本为 `0.2.4`，包名为 `@takboo/dsh-session-bin`。GitHub Release 提供预编译 tarball；npm 通过 trusted publishing 自动发布同一份产物。[dshmarket 收录流程](docs/release.md#dshmarket)独立于 npm 发布，须经目录检查与维护者审核。核心功能的分平台运行证据见[当前桌面兼容性验证](docs/verification/desktop-runtime.md)。

## 界面预览

![原生归档管理与批量选择](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/takboo/dsh-session-bin/v0.2.0/docs/images/archives-light.png)

[深色界面](docs/images/archives-dark.png) · [批量永久删除确认](docs/images/batch-deletion.png)。截图来自 `0.2.0` 的真实安装验收，使用隔离测试会话。

## 兼容性

本版适配 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`，修复 macOS ARM64 桌面版内置运行时被拒绝永久删除的问题，见[桌面兼容性验证](docs/verification/desktop-runtime.md)。此前 CLI/Web 的 SDK 适配证据见[rc.2 验证](docs/verification/dsh-0.2.1-rc2.md)。使用 DSH `0.2.1-rc.1` 时请保留插件 `0.2.1`；旧宿主 `0.2.0-rc.2` 对应插件 `0.2.0`。

永久删除仅对以下精确运行时及环境启用，使用单 Host 和已验证的 JSONL raw/zstd 存储组合：

| 宿主运行时 | 已验收环境 | CPU 架构 | 文件系统 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 独立 Node `24.18.1` / libuv `1.52.1` | Windows Server 2025 | x64 | NTFS |
| 独立 Node `24.18.1` / libuv `1.52.1` | macOS 15 | Apple Silicon ARM64、Intel x64 | APFS |
| 独立 Node `24.18.1` / libuv `1.52.1` | Ubuntu 24.04 | ARM64、x64 | ext2/ext3/ext4 family（type `0xef53`） |
| Electron `44.7.0` / Node `24.21.0` / libuv `1.52.1` | macOS 15 桌面运行时 | Apple Silicon ARM64 | APFS |

表格记录实际验收环境，不代表所有 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 版本均已验证。Windows ARM64、其他桌面架构/版本、普通 Node `24.21.0` 及未验证的存储组合不在永久删除支持范围内。永久删除还会检查宿主源码、资源身份和当前状态；不满足条件时明确拒绝。完整准入与限制见 [Host 生命周期](docs/host-lifecycle.md)。

## 安装

从 npm 安装已发布的预编译包：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @takboo/dsh-session-bin@0.2.4
```

以上命令使用已安装的 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`，将完整插件 bundle 安装到 `web` profile。已验证的 macOS ARM64 桌面版请在 `desktop` profile 的插件管理页面安装同一个 npm 包，并重新启动该 profile 的宿主。启动或重新启动该 profile 后，从侧栏打开“会话回收站”（Session Bin）。发布包包含预编译 Host 和 Client，使用者安装时无需编译 TypeScript；其 tarball 已通过真实 CLI/GUI 验证。

卸载同一 profile 中的插件：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @takboo/dsh-session-bin
```

也可下载 [v0.2.4 Release](https://github.com/takboo/dsh-session-bin/releases/tag/v0.2.4) 中的三个附件，核对 `SHA256SUMS` 后运行 `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-session-bin.tgz`。自行构建时，先完成下方[开发入门](#开发入门)，再运行 `mise exec -- pnpm exec npm pack --ignore-scripts`。

如安装过早期未加 scope 的开发包，先从同一 profile 卸载 `dsh-session-bin`，再安装 scoped 包，避免重复注册；原生归档和已有操作记录保留。分发契约见[发布文档](docs/release.md)。

### 自动构建与 Release

每次分支 push 或 PR 的 Linux x64 验收通过后，[GitHub Actions](https://github.com/takboo/dsh-session-bin/actions/workflows/host-lifecycle.yml) 提供 `release-payload` artifact，包含真实测试过的 tarball、校验文件和提交信息，供发布前检查。

推送与 `package.json.version` 一致的 `v<version>` tag 时，五个平台全部通过后自动创建 [GitHub Release](https://github.com/takboo/dsh-session-bin/releases)，附上 `dsh-session-bin.tgz`、`SHA256SUMS` 和 `release.json`。预发布版本标记为 prerelease；tag 须指向 `main` 历史中的提交。版本 tag 的推送就是发布触发操作，流程见[发布文档](docs/release.md#自动-tarball-release)。

## 使用

1. 使用 Harness 原生“归档会话”操作归档目标会话。
2. 打开“会话回收站”，搜索或筛选已有归档；选择单项或多项取消归档。
3. 永久删除时，核对确认窗口中的对象和阻止原因，再确认执行。设置中的“永久删除会话前进行确认”默认开启；关闭后，点击单项删除、删除所选或清空将直接开始永久删除。
4. 批量操作期间查看进度和日志，完成后只保留统计及需要处理的项。如出现部分失败或连接中断，先检查操作状态，再决定是否继续。

**“清空全部归档”包含点击时的全部归档，搜索和工作区筛选不会缩小其范围。** 批量删除固定开始时的对象，后来新增的归档不会加入。

永久删除不可撤销，仅允许已归档、无活动且无未释放读写引用的冷会话；删除准备会释放由 API Session 激活且确认空闲的目标 Agent，再复核冷会话条件；活动任务、其他所有者的 Agent 和未释放的读写引用仍会阻止删除。清除范围是目标会话日志及已声明的会话元数据、索引；共享附件、外部副本和独立 fork 会保留。插件不提供共享附件垃圾回收或安全擦除保证，也不支持自动定期清空、跨设备同步或多 Host 协调。可通过 Host 配置 `permanentDeletion: false` 关闭永久删除，配置说明见 [Host 生命周期](docs/host-lifecycle.md)。

## 开发入门

使用 [mise](https://mise.jdx.dev/) 管理工具版本，固定配置在 [mise.toml](mise.toml)。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/takboo/dsh-session-bin.git
cd dsh-session-bin
mise trust
mise install
mise run install
mise run verify
```

`mise run install` 按 frozen lockfile 安装依赖并禁用安装脚本。`mise run verify` 完成类型检查、构建、隔离行为测试和真实 tarball 加载检查；测试使用临时 `DSH_HOME` 与测试会话。

| 命令 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `mise run env` | 查看固定工具版本 |
| `mise run check` | 检查 Host 与 Client 类型 |
| `mise run build` | 生成预编译产物和类型声明 |
| `mise run verify` | 完整本地行为与打包验证 |
| `mise run verify:gui` | 隔离 Web profile 中的双语 CLI/GUI 验证 |
| `mise run verify:desktop` | 已安装桌面 Electron 与真实 ASAR Host 的隔离完整回归 |
| `mise run verify:desktop:gui` | 在已安装桌面 Electron 上运行隔离 Web 双语 CLI/GUI |
| `mise run verify:platform` | 记录实际操作系统的候选组合验收证据 |
| `mise run verify:linux` | 在固定 Node 的 Linux 容器内验证，需要 Docker |

GUI 验证需要可用 Chromium 和 npm registry 网络访问，准备方式见[客户端接口](docs/client-interface.md#构建和检查)。候选验收通过不会自动扩大生产支持矩阵。本地 `.local/` 存放研究快照及测试证据，不进入 Git 或发布包。

## 文档与贡献

欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/takboo/dsh-session-bin/issues) 报告问题或提出功能建议。兼容性问题请提供 DSH/Node 版本、操作系统、架构、文件系统和存储提供方；样本使用测试数据。开发和 PR 约定见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)，代理工作入口见 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)。

- [Host 生命周期](docs/host-lifecycle.md)、[客户端接口](docs/client-interface.md)：正式行为、配置及部署边界。
- [Host 验证](docs/verification/host-lifecycle.md)、[客户端验证](docs/verification/client-interface.md)：分版本的实际检查结果。
- [设计提案](docs/design-proposal.md)、[架构决定](docs/decisions/)：产品模型、候选设计与已选定决策。
- [当前 DSH 接口调研](docs/research/current-dsh-interfaces.md)、[兼容性验证](docs/verification/dsh-0.2-compatibility.md)：SDK 依据与早期探针。
- [分发与发布](docs/release.md)：npm、GitHub Release 和市场提交流程。

## 许可与参考

本项目采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)，版权归 DSH Session Bin contributors。

以下项目为接口、产品设计和兼容性研究提供了参考；本项目未复制这些参考插件的实现代码，也不代表其维护者或 DeepSeek 官方背书。

| 项目 | 参考内容 | 上游许可 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) | 宿主及官方插件接口 | 以上游仓库和各依赖包声明为准 |
| [Seetraum/harness-session-delete](https://github.com/Seetraum/harness-session-delete)（`dsh-session-recycle-bin`） | 归档管理交互及分发方式 | MIT，Copyright 2026 Seetraum |
| [MichengAI/dsh-archive-manager](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-archive-manager) | 永久删除与兼容性研究 | Apache-2.0 |
| [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market)、[awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) | 插件市场与目录规则 | 以上游仓库声明为准 |

版本、源码出处与研究结论见[参考及分发调研](docs/research/reference-and-distribution.md)和[永久删除调研](docs/research/permanent-deletion.md)。项目的 MIT 许可不替代第三方依赖的许可；复用上游代码时须保留适用版权、许可及通知。

plugins.description: Discord and Feishu/Lark channels for DeepSeek Harness: verified identities, shared sessions, native Ask User and progress delivery.
plugins.readme_text:
# Channel Core for DeepSeek Harness

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · [Security](SECURITY.md)

**One plugin for Discord and Feishu/Lark channels**, with shared session routing, verified owner identity, reliable message delivery, and progress/status integration.

## Features

- Discord and Feishu adapters live in the same package with independent credentials and connection lifecycles.
- Map verified direct messages from the same owner to a shared **native DSH session** when explicitly configured.
- Durable inbound receipts, serialized session admission, and native steer/queue/interrupt handling avoid replaying messages.
- Native Ask User interactions and progress/status integration preserve conversational continuity.
- Owner verification guards personal-memory access and cross-channel session transitions.

## Proactive outbound messaging

Channel Core supports agent-initiated outbound messages without a preceding inbound message. The only model-facing channel tool, `channel_send({ text?, imagePath?, filePath?, bindingId?, idempotencyKey? })`, sends to the current native Session's existing and currently authorized Feishu or Discord destination. It has no archive search/read actions or news-specific tools. The trusted host API `ctx.channelCore.sendToBoundSession({ sessionId, text, idempotencyKey, bindingId?, source? })` remains available to schedulers and other plugins; `outboundTargets(sessionId)` returns eligible binding IDs without exposing recipient IDs.

- **Tool scope:** One call sends text, one Feishu image or one Feishu file. File paths must be within the current workspace and are uploaded as media, not sent as a Markdown path. To persist scheduled output to conversation history, use native DSH Schedule bound to the relevant Session.
- **Scope:** A session can send only to its own eligible bindings. Multiple bindings require an explicit `bindingId`; arbitrary recipient IDs and cross-session delivery are not accepted. Group allowlists and current DM/owner permission are checked again on send.
- **Delivery:** Uses the existing durable outbox and platform send adapters, with state `pending`, `sent`, `failed`, or `uncertain`. Reusing a stable idempotency key does not send the same message twice. A potentially delivered but unacknowledged message is **not** blindly retried.
- **Automation:** Jobs can call `channel_send` after creating a report (e.g. a scheduled financial report), or trusted plugins can call `sendToBoundSession` directly. This does **not** automatically broadcast every scheduled result, and it does not grant an agent permission to send to arbitrary accounts.
- **Testing:** `npm test` runs dependency-free public regressions. `npm run test:host` runs the broader integration suite inside a configured DSH developer environment with host peer dependencies. Live Feishu/Discord delivery has been separately exercised locally; CI cannot verify third-party credentials.

## Streaming, Ask User and commands

Discord streams thinking, draft and tool activity in a rolling progress message. Committed interim text can appear as a native blockquote in the completed message, separate from the final answer; unpublished/private reasoning is not promoted to public draft text. Live previews show 📝 without artificial section names.

Feishu supports CardKit component streaming with an IM-card fallback. Draft and thinking have independent visibility switches; disabling thinking does not hide public draft text. Completed turns may retain a collapsed 📝 过程记录 panel when enabled. Refresh limits and optional runtime footers are channel-specific.

On both channels, a submitted Ask User question becomes a read-only receipt of the question and selected or custom answer, with interactive controls removed. Previously committed context remains visible and is not re-sent as a duplicate answer.

Discord uses flat `/new`, `/stop`, `/status`, `/session`, `/answer`, `/prompt`, `/model`, `/think` commands. Feishu supports text `/new`, `/stop`, `/status`, `/session`, `/answer`, `/model`, `/think`. Model selection is constrained to available models and takes effect from the next turn; ambiguous provider selections present candidates.

## Install

Requires a compatible DSH host with the peer services in [package.json](package.json), and credentials for each channel you choose to enable.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Kerberos255/dsh-channel-core
```

Use your DSH profile name. Pin an installation to a Git commit if reproducibility is required. Restart DSH after installing or updating code.

## Quick start

1. Open **Settings → Plugins → Channels & Sessions**.
2. Configure the **Discord** and/or **Feishu** tab, platform credentials, and allowed users/channels. A valid connection alone does not authorize message delivery.
3. Review the owner-identification mode in each channel. Automatic first-DM owner claim occurs only after the incoming message passes channel allow rules; manual owner selection is available.
4. Optional: link owner accounts when you want **the same live DSH session** across channels. Sharing verified long-term memory does not require sharing a session.
5. Send a test DM and check the bound workspace, session, and progress output.

## Security and operational boundaries

A channel owner is verified per bot account; group conversations and unverified users must not inherit personal-memory authority. Session mapping decisions are audited and cannot silently reuse sessions from another workspace. The native Host manages agent execution, cancellations, jobs, and saved histories. The plugin keeps independent delivery and receipt state, not a second model engine.

Settings and channel files are local to DSH; do not upload credentials, binding databases, or historical messages. Source template: [config.example.json](config.example.json).

## Testing and related projects

Run `npm test` for portable regressions. **A green CI run does not prove live Discord, Feishu, or network authentication.** Verify actual bot delivery and UI interactions in your own host.

Related: [Status Cards](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-status-cards) · [Dream & Memory](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-memory-dreaming) · [Lossless Context](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-lossless-context).

MIT licensed. See [LICENSE](LICENSE). Historical release notes: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## Optional task notifications

Channel Core's **General & Sessions → Task notifications** option is off by default. Enabling it reveals a notification-channel selector (None, Feishu, or Discord), limited to channels enabled and configured in the current host. A failed scheduled task may send a brief alert to the verified owner's DM, never to an arbitrary chat. Recipient resolution follows the current authorized channel binding, rather than storing a Session ID, so normal `/new` and archived-session handoffs do not require reconfiguration. If there is no uniquely authorized owner destination, nothing is sent. Alert delivery uses the existing durable channel queue and stable idempotency keys; an unavailable host cannot guarantee alerts during downtime.

Other plugins remain independent: they can optionally emit `dsh/task-alert` with a trusted task identifier, task kind, source and terminal state after persisting the failure. Channel Core handles selection, authorization, and delivery. Dream emits this event only on a scheduled workflow's first transition to `failed`; manual runs and successful/empty runs remain silent. Payloads exclude private conversation text, model errors and memory artifacts. No channel plugin is required to run Dream.

## Sending ordinary files to Feishu

The existing Session-scoped `channel_send` tool also supports `{filePath:"_scratch/report.pdf"}` to send an **actual downloadable Feishu file attachment**. Supported formats include PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ZIP, 7z, RAR, TXT, CSV, Markdown, JSON and related document formats (max 30 MB per file). Images continue to use `imagePath`.

Files are restricted to the current authorized Session workspace, validated by canonical path and content sig

plugins.description: Click any sentence in an AI chat to turn it into a card, then hang the cards into your own knowledge tree. DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin + standalone web app. 从对话里把有用的句子挑出来，挂成自己的知识树。
plugins.readme_text:
# knowledge_database — 从对话里把有用的那几句挑出来，挂成你自己的知识树 ![点一句成一张卡、框一段合成一张、拖动合并、挂成一棵树](docs/demo.gif) **快速开始**（macOS / Linux，要 Python 3.11 和 Rust 工具链）： ```bash git clone https://github.com/lo2589/knowledge_database.git git clone https://github.com/lo2589/FastNode.git Node # 底层节点库，必须放在同一层、目录名叫 Node cd knowledge_database ./setup.sh # 建 .venv、从 ../Node 编 FastNode、装 PDF/Word 读取库 .venv/bin/python -m km --chat # 网页版：左边 Codex 对话，右边知识图 ``` 装进 dsh 用：再跑 `./dsh-install.sh`，重启 dsh（见[第八节](#八装与跑)）。 跟 agent 聊一下午，真正学到的可能就三五句，混在几百句里，过几天就找不到了。这个工具做的事： 1. **拆**：对话、文档拆成一句一句；表格按一条字段数据拆（带行标识和列名）；段落里连续的 `A：… B：…` / `1) … 2) …` 记录逐条拆。公式、代码、图保持完整。 2. **挑**：在左边的对话里点句子（一句一张卡），或者**按住 Ctrl 框一段话**一次入库一批。 3. **入库**：留下的做成卡片，每张卡记得来自原文哪句，点一下跳回去。 4. **检查**：LLM 说的不一定对。每张卡标「对 / 改正过 / 存疑 / 错」，写上依据。 5. **归纳**：自己把卡挂进层级树，再连上别的关系（前提、例子、细化、矛盾、相关）。 6. **看**：严格层级树像 mermaid 那样从上往下画；一层排不下就折行，**画布宽度有上限**（卡片不会被甩到几千像素外）；折叠起来的子树不占位置，兄弟节点自动靠拢；画面外的东西在四边留一条可点的「接字」；排版跟着面板宽度走，你看的位置、折叠、模式会被记住。 7. **带走**：一键导出 Markdown 大纲 / Mermaid 图 / JSON / **PDF**，或把某张卡连同它的下级写进对话框接着问。 8. **不装 dsh 也能用**：网页版 `/chat` 左边是 **Codex 对话**、右边是同一张知识图——聊完一段，把有用的句子点进图里。 为什么结构要自己挂、不让 AI 自动挂：AI 画的结构图更整齐，但人记不住；自己挂的更乱，记得反而牢。挂的这一下就是学习。 （需求清单、功能对照这类工作笔记留在本地，不随仓库发布。） --- ## 一、界面：一屏两半，不切换 ``` ┌──────────── dsh 对话 ────────────┬──────────────── 知识库 ────────────────┐ │ 你问：残差学习是什么？… │ 库里有什么 │ 知识图（严格层级树） │ │ 回答（每一句都能点）： │ 25 张卡… │ ┌─────┐ │ │ ▍H(x) = F(x) + x ✓已入库 │ 最近入库 │ │ 根 │ │ │ ▍F(x) 是残差函数… ✓已入库 │ 目录（树） │ ┌──┴──┐ ┌──┐ │ │ ▍梯度里天然带着 +1… │ ● Block │ │Block│──│…│ 彩色线=关系 │ │ │ ● 残差… │ └─────┘ └──┘ │ └──────────────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` - **左边是 dsh 自己的对话**，回答用 dsh 原本的 Markdown 渲染（公式、代码、表格都不变），每一句都能点。 - **右边是知识库，一直开着**：装成共享右栏（`dsh-plugin-rightbar`）里的「知识图」标签，和别的插件并排住在一栏；没装那个右栏时退回自己贴右边的**浮动面板**（拖它的左边缘调宽度，宽度记在 `km-panel-w`）。 - 白板页面自己的文件一改，页面 3 秒内自己重载（`/api/version` 轮询），不用手动刷新。 --- ## 二、左边对话怎么用（逐句入库） | 动作 | 结果 | |---|---| | **点一句** | 这句变成右边知识图里的一张卡，挂在「挂载点」下面；这句标上 `✓ 已入库` | | **再点已入库的那句** | 不在右边找：直接跳到那张卡（高亮闪一下） | | **Ctrl / ⌘ + 拖一个框** | 框住的句子全部标蓝，下面出现小条：**合成一张卡**（这些句子合成**一张**卡，正文按顺序连起来，每句的出处都留着）/ **取消**。已经入库的句子自动跳过，`Esc` 清空选择。**多选就是一张卡**——框出来的是一块知识，不是一堆卡 | | 流式回答 | 回答还在生成时不显示可点句子，生成完自动变成可点 | | 用户消息、追问消息 | 一样逐句可点，来源记的是你自己说的话（`user:序号`） | 入库时一并记下：会话 id、消息 id、句子在消息里的位置、**这句话在第几轮**、说话人，以及它回答的那个问题（卡片「原文」里显示的就是这个问题）。 ## 三、右边白板怎么用 ### 顶上那一行 | 控件 | 用法 | |---|---| | `☰` | 展开/收起左边「库里有什么」目录栏（收起后图面占满视野；开合状态按会话记住） | | `☷` | 脑图 ⇄ **Outliner**（一条一条的列表视图）切换，状态记住 | | `⌁` | 关系索引：六种关系的颜色、说明和计数 | | `＋` | 新建卡片：写标题（可留空，自动取正文首句）和正文（支持 Markdown / 公式），然后 **挂到当前节点** 或 **挂到选中的卡下面**（后者＝在那张卡下写一条子信息，不动挂载点）；`⌘↵` 等于保存 | | 搜索框 | **像 Word 的查找**：回车 / `↓` 跳下一个，`Shift+回车` / `↑` 跳上一个（也可以点旁边的 `↑` `↓`），右边显示 `3 / 12`；**被折叠起来的分支会自动打开**。`Esc` 清空。
